Every page is authorized again; any change to the bound effective authority rejects continuation, while an unrelated policy publication does not. The token also binds execution context, principal, credential mode/method and the service route. scanStatus is more when upstream candidates remain, scan_budget when a bounded scan stopped before exhaustion, or exhausted when no continuation remains. An empty page with more or scan_budget can still continue. On a rejected continuation, repeat the search without the token.
search.results: Searches current pages only and returns structured JSON metadata without bodies. Text mode matches titles; use CQL text ~ for full text. Created/updated actor and time metadata are returned when supplied.
search.spaceKeys: Omit spaces to search effective authorized access; explicit keys only narrow it and wildcard keys are unsupported. Use exact space keys, including the tilde and case of personal keys such as ~alice. In CQL quote personal keys, for example space = "~alice". A personal-space grant does not imply ownership.

inputExamples.label: Exclude spaces and content IDs within authorized access

query.value: space NOT IN (ARCHIVE, SANDBOX) AND id != 12345

search.typedCommand: Typed CLI wrapper: agent-access confluence page search [OPTIONS]; run agent-access confluence page search --help for flags and input alternatives.
search.scope: Search selects one global winning grant band and credential mode. Broker compiles every winning inclusion/exclusion and the independent token boundary into CQL before adding caller filters, then validates every released result. Counts describe released results, not upstream totals; bounded scans can return an empty page with confidential continuation.
search.resourceIdentities: Disclosed confluence_content selectors use stable https://<site>/wiki/content/{page|folder|blog}/<ID> identities. They are not browser URLs or search text. Search current authorized content normally; explicit spaces narrow current placement.

space.list.request: Omitting maxResults uses the configured maximum advertised by this action (50 in the default configuration, at most 100). Returns structured JSON space metadata without bodies. Keep actual space keys, including personal-space tilde and case; a personal-space grant does not imply ownership.
space.list.typedCommand: Typed CLI wrapper: agent-access confluence space list [OPTIONS]; run agent-access confluence space list --help for flags and input alternatives.
space.list.scope: Space resources authorize this listing. Page, folder and blog resources confer no containing-space authority.

verify.scope: Authorize the current page location using space, exact-page or page/folder subtree resources. Owner-bound comment and attachment actions resolve the actual page and membership; each action needs its own permission. An exact page does not cover child pages.
verify.expectations: Give at least one of expectVersion, expectTitle or expectAttachmentId with the current-content locator. Read verification.status to distinguish matched from mismatch. The structured JSON result preserves the verification outcome without body content.
verify.typedCommand: Typed CLI wrapper: agent-access confluence page verify [OPTIONS] <PAGE_ID>; run agent-access confluence page verify --help for flags and input alternatives.
verify.resourceIdentities: A disclosed /wiki/content/page/ID selector is a stable identity, not a browser URL. Extract its immutable ID and supply pageId. Exact identity follows the same object after an external move; space/token boundaries still test current placement. Browser URL alternatives must name the resolved current space key or alias.
